title: ADR-0141 runtime: pre-install dependency check (`dependency_missing`, 422) at the three install doors, plus dependency-declared namespace co-owners and the dependency-ordered rehydrate
body:
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed — the runtime card ADR-0141 §Execution plan item 1 names, owed by landed work (PR #25717, merge `afe6ab9ccc`)
Ruling: #25403 comment 6369704387 (B′, maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-23T16:28:30Z): "Then one runtime card for the pre-install check (XS–S) with the console's refusal text, plus docs"; comment 6377678758 (letter A, 「同意 #8」 2026-10-24T00:40:55Z): "objectql S (one more source for `coOwners`, plus a test), riding with the B′ runtime pre-install card"
Business reason: the ruling's own words — 「如果这样，hotcrm 岂不是真实的可以分拆出很多模块」/「而每个包可以独立安装」. Today an app that depends on another installs anyway and fails later at its first cross-app save; and a HotCRM module shipped as its own artifact (revenue first, hotcrm#2271) is refused by the namespace gate next to HotCRM. Without this card, composite products keep shipping as one artifact.
Reader: the `domain:services` / objectql lane, one PR touching `packages/metadata-core`, `packages/metadata-protocol`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, `packages/cloud-connection`, `packages/objectql`, `packages/services/service-package`, and the Console refusal text
Dedupe (open AND closed): "pre-install dependency check dependency_missing install refuse missing dependency" → 0; "ADR-0141 inter-app dependency runtime card" → 7, none a runtime card (#25403 is the decision card); "namespace co-owner declared dependency install gate object name uniqueness cross-artifact" → 1 (#14122, closed, the ADR-0130 in-artifact case)
Size: S (ADR-0141's estimate). Siblings: author-side range rule card (released with or before this one) and snapshot-alignment card, cut together from the same plan.

## What to build (ADR-0141, `docs/adr/0141-inter-app-dependency-declared-checked-before-install.md`)

1. **D2 — the pre-install check.** One predicate, called at the three install acts and nowhere else:
   - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-install.ts#installPackage`;
   - the bare-registry fallback of `POST /api/v1/packages` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`);
   - `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`), before the manifest service sees the artifact.

   Each entry `(id, range)` of the installed package's own `manifest.dependencies` is satisfied when `id` is installed (`SchemaRegistry.getPackage`) at a `manifest.version` inside `range`, or is delivered by the same artifact (presence only). Otherwise the whole install is refused before anything registers: `status` 422, a `code` registered in the ADR-0112 D3 ledger, and one `AppCompatibilityCheck` issue per unmet entry (`severity: 'error'`, `category: 'dependency_missing'`, message naming the id, the range and what was found). Every unmet entry is reported in one answer. An unparsable range or version does not satisfy (fail closed). ⛔ Not at the re-registration paths (code packages at `init`/`start`, the `sys_packages` rehydrate, the install-local `kernel:ready` rehydrate), and ⛔ not at `PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id`.
2. **The range reader.** One sibling function in `packages/metadata-core/src/protocol-handshake.ts`, sharing the handshake's alternative/comparator parsing, at exact-version granularity. The card states the grammar it supports: at least `^`, `~`, `>=`, an `x` wildcard, `||` and the space intersection, so 「HotCRM 6.x」 reads. `assertProtocolCompat`'s verdicts and ADR-0087 D1's never-false-rejection contract stay unchanged. ⛔ No fourth reader (`rangeAdmitsMajor`, `parseRangeFloor`, `SemanticVersionManager` are the three that exist).
3. **The Console refusal text**, in the author's terms (「请先安装 HotCRM 6.x」), from the refusal's facts.
4. **D5 — dependency-declared co-owners.** A second source for the co-owner set the namespace gate and `refuseCoOwnedObjectNameCollision` both read (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, `NamespaceConflictError`): a package that declares X and uses X's namespace co-owns it with X, and with X's other declared dependents that use it (sibling arm). One-way, read from either end, whichever registers first. Tests extend the ADR-0130 D3 gate test: a cross-artifact pair and a sibling pair (a dependent defining an object name X owns, and a sibling defining a name the other sibling owns, are refused; assert `code` and `status`, message worded per co-ownership source), and the upgrade case (X reinstalled beside its module is admitted; X newly defining a name the module owns is refused).
5. **D5 — rehydrate order.** The `sys_packages` and install-local rehydrates sort their own batch through `resolvePluginOrder` (`packages/core/src/plugin-order.ts`), ledger entries as nodes. A cycle degrades to source order with a logged refusal and never throws out of the hydrate.
6. **D8 items 2 and 3.** A stated fate for `optional` (no record spelling; a snapshot never produces it and D2 never reads it until decided), and for `AppManifestSchema.dependencies` (project from the record, or retire through the ADR-0087 conversion layer, decided on a measured reader count).
7. **Docs (§Execution plan item 4).** The package-authoring guide states how to declare a dependency, the range grammar, what the install refusal means, that two modules of one app need not declare each other, and that `os validate` cannot see a dependency's objects.

## First readings (ADR-0141 §Open items 2, 3, 4, 6)

- **2:** whether a dependent on one hydrate path can have its parent on a later one, and whether the `kernel:ready` seals in `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` run before or after the ledger rehydrate on the same hook.
- **3:** a declared id that names no installable package, if HotCRM's manifests carry one. Report it; D2 does not exempt it.
- **4:** what `enabled: false` on X should mean for a dependent, measured against the save door's closure and the data door today.
- **6:** that the artifact `os build` writes for a standalone module carries `type: 'app'`, and what each install door does today with a top-level package of another type.

## Out of scope

D3's deferred items (uninstall protection, upgrade interception, topological/cascade install, owner-side publish marker, marketplace version negotiation, judging a post-install `dependencies` edit). D8 item 1 (record-to-array snapshot conversion) is the snapshot-alignment card. HotCRM-side work (D4 readings, D7 preconditions) is the HotCRM lane, hotcrm#2271.
